subject: Privacy + Security follow-up — HealthNow telemetry & questionnaire
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Karen Lee <karen.lee@healthnow.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Privacy + Security follow-up — HealthNow telemetry & questionnaire

Hi Karen,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in process — we can share our latest interim report and provide the expected attestation timeline (target: Q3 2027).
- GDPR/HIPAA: Our hosted product supports regional data controls and signed BAA options for covered customers. We encrypt data at rest and in transit; we also offer VPC/private deployment for additional isolation.
- Telemetry & cookies: The Console collects operational telemetry (latency, error rates, route traces) and product telemetry (feature usage). We do not drop third-party trackers on customer consoles; cookies are limited to session and auth (see attached cookie map).

Attached: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (security summary), redwood_privacy_cookie_map.csv (field-level cookie/telemetry mapping).

Next steps I propose:
1) You send the HealthNow Security Questionnaire (or we can intake it on your portal).
2) We schedule a short session with our security lead to walk through any high-risk items.
3) We provide specific artifacts (interim SOC report, encryption docs, BAA draft).

Could you confirm who will own the questionnaire on your side and whether a demo of the Console telemetry is helpful for the security reviewers?

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192
From: Karen Lee <karen.lee@healthnow.org>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy + Security follow-up — HealthNow telemetry & questionnaire

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. I own the questionnaire for this project. I attached an initial copy (HealthNow_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) with a combination of high-level and operational questions. A few notes up front:

- We need explicit confirmation around HIPAA (BAA required) and what data fields would be considered PHI if ingested.
- For telemetry, our InfoSec team will want to understand retention windows and whether any identifiers are collected by default.
- Would prefer a 30–45 minute technical call this week with your security engineer.

I’ve looped Sam Irwin (sec ops) from our InfoSec to coordinate.

Thanks,
Karen Lee
Director, Platform & Integration | HealthNow Medical Systems

Attachments: HealthNow_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: HealthNow questionnaire + Karen notes — need artifacts and quick answers

Marissa/Rafael — forwarding HealthNow's questionnaire (attached). Key asks flagged by Karen: HIPAA/BAA confirmation, PHI field list, telemetry retention/identifiers, SOC 2 timeline. Can you help with the short (one-paragraph) answers for the questionnaire and confirm which artifacts we can share immediately?

Specific asks:
- Marissa: can you pull the latest interim SOC notes and the encryption at-rest/in-transit statement? If we can share a redacted controls matrix that helps.
- Rafael: can you confirm default telemetry retention and whether session IDs are pseudonymized by default? I expect we can say 90 days default, configurable up to 2 years for enterprise customers, and that session IDs are hashed; please confirm.

If we get these by EOD today I’ll populate the spreadsheet and send back to Karen and Sam. I expect a technical call to follow — propose Thu 2027-04-20 at 10:00 PT.

Thanks — Diego
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HealthNow questionnaire + Karen notes — need artifacts and quick answers

Diego/Rafael —

Short answers and artifacts:

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II in flight; current interim report (redacted) is available. I attached a one-page summary (Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf) that we can send. Final attestation expected Q3 2027.
- HIPAA/BAA: We support a standard BAA. We treat PHI fields as customer-controlled — common PHI patterns (name, DOB, SSNs, contact info, medical codes). We recommend customers redact PHI before ingestion unless covered by BAA and private deployment.
- Telemetry retention & identifiers: Default telemetry retention is 90 days; enterprise configs allow retention up to 2 years. Operational telemetry is aggregated; session IDs are hashed and stored separately from PII. I confirm we can offer a 30-day retention profile for demo/test tenants.

Artifacts I can share now: redwood_privacy_cookie_map.csv, the one-pager, and our standard BAA template (I will request legal to prep the BAA draft once HealthNow signals interest).

I put a placeholder Drive link for the redacted interim SOC: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C_RedwoodSecurity

I’ll be available for the technical call Thu 2027-04-20 10:00 PT.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Karen Lee <karen.lee@healthnow.org>, Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@securops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy + Security follow-up — HealthNow telemetry & questionnaire

Karen/Sam —

Thanks for the prompt turnaround and for sharing the questionnaire. Per Marissa's notes above, attached are: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf and redwood_privacy_cookie_map.csv. We will populate the HealthNow_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx with initial responses by EOD tomorrow and propose the technical call for Thu 2027-04-20 10:00 PT (please confirm availability).

Quick answers:
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA. We recommend private deployment or BAA-covered hosted contracts for PHI.
- PHI fields: Common PHI includes patient identifiers and medical codes — customers control ingestion; we can provide a mapping to help HealthNow identify fields to redact.
- Telemetry: Default retention 90 days, configurable up to 2 years. Session identifiers are hashed; only aggregated operational metrics include PII-free identifiers.

Next actions for HealthNow:
1) Confirm who will join the technical call (security engineer + platform owner).
2) Accept the proposed time or suggest alternatives.
3) Tell us whether you'd like the questionnaire returned as a spreadsheet or via your vendor portal.

Best,
Diego

Attachments in thread: HealthNow_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx; Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf; redwood_privacy_cookie_map.csv
